findings.claim: The body of WIP commit 282623928fdb on `rgr/TASK-0013` contains the literal text `\n\n` instead of real line breaks, so the Sources and Co-authored-by lines sit in the same paragraph. As a result, git does not parse the Co-authored-by trailer. This is cosmetic and does not affect preservation, but the recorded authorship is weaker.
findings.fix: Optional: at resume, or when the WIP is rewritten or discarded, record authorship with real trailers. Do not rewrite the branch just for this.
